relationships.paper: Evaluating and Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models: Can They Still See Removed Objects?
relationships.evidence: To ensure that oDPO effectively mitigates object hallucinations in LVLMs, we conduct evaluations on four widely used object hallucination benchmarks: Object HalBench (Rohrbach et al., 2018), MME-Hall (Fu et al., 2023), AMBER (Wang et al., 2023a) and MMHalBench (Sun et al., 2024).
